checkpoint_scores.name: tempo
checkpoint_scores.message: Good tempo - 2.8:1 backswing:downswing (inside the tour range 2.72-4.71:1). Your downswing was 170 ms; at the tour ratio that wants a 462-801 ms backswing, and yours was 480. You swing with a quicker tempo than 84% of 1399 tour swings.

checkpoint_scores.name: head_sway
checkpoint_scores.message: Good head stability - 0.06 shoulder-widths of lateral head movement to impact (nicely centered over the ball). That is less head movement than 81% of 458 tour swings.

checkpoint_scores.name: finish_balance
checkpoint_scores.message: Balanced finish - the body settles within 0.03 shoulder-widths through the follow-through (held and steady). That is a steadier finish than at least 90% of 458 tour swings.

checkpoint_scores.name: hip_sway
checkpoint_scores.message: Good lower-body movement - 0.22 shoulder-widths of lateral hip travel to impact (inside the tour range 0.14-0.5). That is less hip travel than 74% of 458 tour swings.

checkpoint_scores.name: hip_shift_at_top
checkpoint_scores.message: Steady hips going back - 0.16 shoulder-widths of lateral hip travel to the top (centered over the ball at the top). That is more hip slide going back than 80% of 458 tour swings.

checkpoint_scores.name: head_stays_back
checkpoint_scores.message: Head stayed behind the ball - 0.16 shoulder-widths of separation opened up between head and hips through impact (inside the tour range). That is less head-behind separation than 88% of 458 tour swings.

measurements.name: tempo_ratio
measurements.detail: backswing:downswing time, from phase instants; frame rate cancels

measurements.name: backswing_ms
measurements.detail: motion start -> top, from phase instants; real-time clips only, fps does not cancel

measurements.name: downswing_ms
measurements.detail: top -> impact, from phase instants; real-time clips only, fps does not cancel

measurements.name: head_sway_norm
measurements.detail: |dx| of ear midpoint, address window -> impact window

measurements.name: finish_balance_norm
measurements.detail: p90 hip-center drift through follow-through

measurements.name: hip_sway_norm
measurements.detail: |dx| of hip midpoint, address window -> impact window

measurements.name: hip_shift_at_top_norm
measurements.detail: |dx| of hip midpoint, address window -> transition window

measurements.name: head_hip_offset_impact_norm
measurements.detail: signed (head - hips) dx over the impact window; + is image-right, camera-frame — carries a static camera bias, see head_hip_gain_norm

measurements.name: head_hip_gain_norm
measurements.detail: change in signed (head - hips) dx, address window -> impact window, one shared shoulder-width ruler; + is image-right, camera-frame, handedness resolved when judged

measurements.name: hand_separation_norm
measurements.detail: mean per-frame wrist-to-wrist distance over the address window; mixes x and y, so it carries the frame's pixel aspect where the lateral metrics cancel it

measurements.name: hand_height_norm
measurements.detail: signed (wrists - shoulders) dy over the address window, + is hands below shoulders; a y quantity over an x ruler, so it carries the frame's pixel aspect. Not handedness-relative

measurements.name: hand_offset_from_hips_norm
measurements.detail: signed (wrists - hips) dx over the address window; + is image-right, camera-frame, handedness resolved when judged. x over x, so the frame's pixel aspect cancels

measurements.name: trail_hand_roll_deg
measurements.detail: PROXY: circular-mean angle of the trail wrist-to-index-knuckle vector off image-vertical at address, + is image-right. Two points on one hand, not grip rotation about the shaft

measurements.name: tour_joint_distance
measurements.detail: Mahalanobis distance of the six metrics as a combination, against 458 face-on tour swings; more unusual than 87% of them. Largest contributor: head_hip_gain_norm

measurements.name: face_to_path_deg
measurements.detail: club face angle minus club path; + is face open to path (fade shape)

measurements.name: start_line_deg
measurements.detail: initial horizontal launch direction; + is right of target

measurements.name: carry_distance_yds
measurements.detail: carry as printed by the launch monitor; meaningful per club, not across a bag

measurements.name: total_distance_yds
measurements.detail: carry plus roll as printed; the gap to carry is the ground, not the swing

measurements.name: start_line_offline_yds
measurements.detail: yards right (+) or left of target the ball started, projected to the carry; not where it finished - the curve is face_to_path_deg

measurements.name: ball_speed_mph
measurements.detail: ball speed off the face as printed by the launch monitor; a fitting input, judged by nothing

measurements.name: launch_angle_deg
measurements.detail: vertical launch angle as printed; start_line_deg is the horizontal one

measurements.name: flight_carry_yds
measurements.detail: SIMULATED carry from the printed launch conditions; not the launch monitor's own carry, which is carry_distance_yds

measurements.name: flight_apex_yds
measurements.detail: SIMULATED peak height above the tee; the screen prints no apex tile at all

measurements.name: flight_descent_angle_deg
measurements.detail: SIMULATED angle below the horizontal at landing, read off the landing velocity

measurements.name: flight_time_s
measurements.detail: SIMULATED hang time from launch to landing

measurements.name: flight_landing_offline_yds
measurements.detail: SIMULATED yards right (+) or left of target the ball FINISHED; recorded only when the spin axis resolved, so unlike start_line_offline_yds this is a landing point

notes: no down-the-line view in this bundle — face-on analysis only
